decision.observation: 19:46.332: after the Space tap the idle dots returned to all-white/gray (they had been blue) — Space reliably changes the idle dot display but never produces movement. Timer advances every step (19:44→19:46), so the game is not paused; the car alone is unresponsive. Van remains nose-to-shore on the verge with the pine trunk at its right and open asphalt one car-width away.
decision.hypothesis: At stage start the car needed two consecutive Enter presses ('begin stage', then 'go!') to be released. A stuck car may need the same re-arm sequence, which two isolated Enter presses separated by other keys never formed.
decision.memory: Consecutive Enter ('begin stage' + 'go!') was required at stage start; test an unbroken Enter-Enter chain.
